title: Collections Desk Reference: Charges Billed After a Disconnect Notice and Held Out of a Payment Arrangement
content:
**Collections desk reference — Payment Arrangements (Deferred Payment Agreements)**
**Charges billed since a disconnect notice, held back from the amount moved**

Which charges billed since an outstanding disconnect notice are held back from the amount moved into the agreement — to be paid with the bill rather than spread — follows the payment record of the member's Electric Service by Rate Schedule account. The charges concerned are those billed for the latest billing period, where that bill was issued after the notice.

| Outstanding disconnect notice | Latest bill issued after the notice date | Returned payment posted in the twelve months ending on the transfer day | Charges held back |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | at least one | the service fees and late payment charges of the latest billing period |
| yes | yes | none | the service fees of the latest billing period alone |
| yes | no — issued on or before the notice date | — | nothing for charges |
| no | — | — | nothing for charges |

**Terms.** A disconnect notice is *outstanding* when the service account shows a disconnect notice date. The *latest bill* is the most recent usage bill on the service account, with its bill date and billing period; it is *issued after the notice* when its bill date is later than the notice date.

**Hypothetical account:** notice dated September 3; latest bill dated September 18 for period 2025-09 with a service fee of $25.00 and a late payment charge of $6.40.
- With a returned payment in the twelve months: $31.40 is selected to be held back.
- Without one: $25.00 is selected.
- Had the latest bill been dated September 1: nothing is selected for charges.
